subject: Clear go-criteria and exit tests for BlueSky pilot
messages:
From: Blake Turner <blake.turner@blueskylabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@blueskylabs.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP kickoff — request for explicit success criteria and acceptance tests

Hi Ava / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to kick off the pilot. Procurement asked us to share a concise list of the success criteria and acceptance tests so they can align their approval and payment timeline. Can you send a MAP-style rundown that: 1) lists the measurable success metrics, 2) defines the exit gates (go/no-go), and 3) enumerates acceptance tests for the pilot cutover?

I've attached the draft MAP we worked on internally (BlueSky_MAP_v1.xlsx). High-level constraints: pilot must be contained to a single product line, run for two weeks of real traffic, and provide per-request latency percentiles.

Primary stakeholders on our side: Ellen Park (product), me (engineering lead), and procurement.

Appreciate a versioned MAP and a short timeline to close.

Best,
Blake

--
Blake Turner
Engineering Lead, BlueSky Labs
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Blake Turner <blake.turner@blueskylabs.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@blueskylabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP kickoff — request for explicit success criteria and acceptance tests

Hi Blake / Ellen — attaching an updated MAP (BlueSky_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a short acceptance_tests.md that lays out the exact checks we'll run during the pilot. Summary of the proposed success criteria and exit gates below so it's easy to scan: 

- Primary success metrics (must be met for a 'go'):
  • 95th percentile generation latency <= 450 ms across pilot traffic (measured at request boundary)
  • End-to-end inference cost per 1k requests <= $12 (after caching & batching)
  • End-user quality: error rate on a 200-sample test set <= 4% (semantic correctness false positives)
  • SLO for availability >= 99.5% during pilot window

- Exit gates / Go criteria:
  1) All primary metrics met for a continuous 3-day window during the pilot (can be non-consecutive days if agreed)
  2) No unresolved critical security/compliance findings from the security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence checklist items completed)
  3) Successful completion of the acceptance test suite (see acceptance_tests.md) with documented test runs and logs

- Acceptance tests (high level):
  • Latency sweep: synthetic load at 1x/2x expected pilot QPS, measure p50/p95/p99
  • Cost validation: run a representative prompt mix against the billing trace and verify per-1k cost threshold
  • Quality checks: run the 200-sample human-evaluated set and confirm <= 4% failure rate; include a small adversarial set to detect regressions
  • Failover exercise: route 10% of traffic to a fallback model variant for 6 hours and verify graceful degradation and logs

Attachments: BlueSky_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with timeline and owners), acceptance_tests.md (detailed test steps), SLA_outline.pdf (billing & support expectations).

Proposed close timeline: finalize MAP and acceptance tests by Wed 2026-08-05, procurement sign-off by Mon 2026-08-09, pilot start Tue 2026-08-11, pilot end Tue 2026-08-25, decision/close meeting Fri 2026-08-28. If procurement needs a faster cadence, we can compress the sign-off to 48 hours with a pay-on-success clause.

Next steps: Blake / Ellen — can you confirm the timeline and if the cost target aligns with your expectations? Marcus / Monica — please review the exit gates for operational feasibility.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Blake Turner <blake.turner@blueskylabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP kickoff — request for explicit success criteria and acceptance tests

Ava / Blake — quick ops check from my side: the latency and failover tests look fine. A couple of operational notes:

- For the 95th percentile requirement, we'll need to pin sequence length assumptions in the MAP (I added a note in BlueSky_MAP_v2.xlsx). If BlueSky's payload distribution skews longer, p95 could move up.
- For the cost validation test, we'll want a copy of the prompt mix and any augmented prompts (e.g., system messages) — Blake, can you share that as a CSV?
- Logging: we'll provide per-request trace IDs and a sample of KV cache hit rates in the acceptance doc.

I'll run the failover exercise during the pilot second week and coordinate with Marcus for kernel/quantization settings if we need to tweak performance.

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Blake Turner <blake.turner@blueskylabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@blueskylabs.com>, procurement@blueskylabs.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP kickoff — request for explicit success criteria and acceptance tests

Thanks — this is excellent. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Prompt mix CSV attached (see: prompt_mix_aug.csv) — includes sample distribution and expected QPS.
2) Procurement asks that the go/no-go decision include a one-time credit clause in case of missed p95 latency on day one. Is Redwood willing to offer a $5k credit if the p95 exceeds 600 ms on the first day and the team can’t remediate within 24 hours?
3) One additional acceptance test request from Product: a small A/B quality test comparing Redwood output to their current rule-based baseline on a 500-sample live set. They'd like to see improvement or parity on task accuracy.

If you're OK with the credit clause as a safety valve and the AB test added to acceptance_tests.md, procurement can sign off next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Blake
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Blake Turner <blake.turner@blueskylabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@blueskylabs.com>, procurement@blueskylabs.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP kickoff — request for explicit success criteria and acceptance tests

Blake — thanks for the prompt_mix.csv and the ask list. We're agreeable to the one-time $5k credit clause with the caveat that the remediation window and logs are shared (we'll document the exact remediation steps in the SOW). I've added the A/B quality test to acceptance_tests.md (500-sample live split, blind-eval by BlueSky product).

Finalized items in the updated MAP (links below):
- Success metrics and exit gates (as listed)
- Acceptance test suite (latency sweep, cost validation, 200-sample quality check, 500-sample A/B live comparison, failover exercise)
- Owners: Ava (commercial), Monica (ops), Marcus (runtime tuning), Ellen (BlueSky product), Blake (BlueSky eng)
- Timeline: procurement sign-off targeted Mon 2026-08-09; pilot start Tue 2026-08-11
